title: DENV Titration
author: Fabio Gomes
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zsdf6a6
materials: Dump Methylcellulose overlay and blot on paper towels
Dump off antibody solution. Tap on paper towels

steps.title: Prepare 80% methanol fixative
steps.instruction: Make a fixative solution consisting of 80 % methanol (v/v) in water.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS and dry
steps.instruction: Gently wash the cells with 1X PBS, incubate for 10 minutes, then blot and dry the plates.

steps.title: Fix cells with methanol
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of the 80 % methanol fixative to each well and let the plates sit at room temperature for 10 minutes. Fixed cells may be stored at –70 °C; keep methanol on the cells when freezing.

steps.title: Wash plates post-fixation
steps.instruction: Wash the plates with PBS and incubate for 10 minutes. If using plates that were previously frozen, incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes instead.

substeps.instruction: If frozen plates are used, incubate 30 min at 37 °C

steps.title: Dilute primary antibody (4G2)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:2000 dilution of the 4G2 primary antibody in 5 % skim milk prepared in PBS.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the primary antibody solution to each well, incubate on a rocker at 37 °C for 1 hour, keeping the pipette tip in contact with the well wall to minimize disturbance.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL primary antibody to each well
Maintain pipette tip against well wall

steps.title: Remove primary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Dump off the primary antibody solution and tap the plates on paper towels to remove excess liquid.

steps.title: Wash with skim milk PBS
steps.instruction: Wash each well with 1 mL of 5 % skim milk in PBS.

substeps.instruction: Wash each well with 1 mL 5 % skim milk/PBS

steps.title: Dilute secondary antibody (Anti‑mouse‑Per)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:2000 dilution of the anti‑mouse‑Per secondary antibody in 5 % skim milk in PBS.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the secondary antibody solution to each well and incubate on a rocker at 37 °C for 1 hour.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL secondary antibody to each well

steps.title: Wash plates with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the plates twice with PBS and tap on a paper towel to remove residual liquid.

steps.title: Add TrueBlue substrate
steps.instruction: Add 160 µL of TrueBlue substrate to each well.

steps.title: Develop plaques at room temperature
steps.instruction: Place the plates on a rocker at room temperature and incubate until plaques develop (minimum 10 minutes, longer if needed).

substeps.instruction: Place plates on rocker at RT

steps.title: Count plaques or store plates
steps.instruction: Count plaques immediately, or alternatively store the plates at 4 °C for up to 7 days before counting.

substeps.instruction: Or store plates at 4 °C for up to 7 days before counting
